prompt: Entries in TTLCache (cache/ttl.py) expire about 1000x too late. Fix expiry: an entry set at time t with ttl s is valid while now < t + s, and expired from t + s on. Also fix eviction: when the cache is full and a new key is set, first drop all expired entries, and only if it is still full evict the live entry that expires soonest. Tests use FakeClock from cache/clock.py.
